title: Simulating ODYSSEY LONG TERM
text: ODYSSEY LONG TERM (NCT01507831) tested alirocumab, drug lowers LDL cholesterol, placebo. Alirocumab antibody PCSK9, protein controls much LDL liver clears blood. injected skin every two weeks. trial randomized 2,341 adults high cardiovascular risk whose LDL stayed high highest statin dose take. randomized 2:1: 1,553 alirocumab 788 placebo. Treatment lasted 78 weeks. primary endpoint percent change LDL baseline Week 24. trial’s statistical analysis plan (SAP) analyzes mixed model repeated measures (MMRM) uses every visit Week 4 Week 52.

code: library(clinique)  set.seed(1) ldl <- simulate_odyssey_lt(2341) head(ldl) #> # A tibble: 6 × 14 #>   subject_id treatment   age sex   race  visit     day ldl_baseline   ldl #>   <fct>      <fct>     <dbl> <fct> <fct> <ord>   <dbl>        <dbl> <dbl> #> 1 001-0001   Placebo      62 Male  White Week 4     28         85.0  94.1 #> 2 001-0001   Placebo      62 Male  White Week 8     56         85.0 104.  #> 3 001-0001   Placebo      62 Male  White Week 12    84         85.0 116.  #> 4 001-0001   Placebo      62 Male  White Week 16   112         85.0 133.  #> 5 001-0001   Placebo      62 Male  White Week 24   168         85.0 114.  #> 6 001-0001   Placebo      62 Male  White Week 36   252         85.0  94.0 #> # ℹ 5 more variables: ldl_pct_change <dbl>, hefh <fct>, prior_mi_stroke <fct>, #> #   statin_intensity <fct>, region <fct> fit <- mmrm::mmrm(   ldl_pct_change ~ treatment * visit +     hefh * visit +     prior_mi_stroke * visit +     statin_intensity * visit +     region * visit +     ldl_baseline * visit +     us(visit | subject_id),   data = ldl,   reml = TRUE,   method = "Satterthwaite" )  means <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ treatment | visit, weights = "proportional") #> mmrm() registered as emmeans extension diffs <- summary(emmeans::contrast(means, "revpairwise")) diffs[diffs$visit == "Week 24", ] #>  contrast             visit   estimate  SE   df t.ratio p.value #>  Alirocumab - Placebo Week 24    -62.7 1.3 2332 -48.439 <0.0001 #>  #> Results are averaged over the levels of: hefh, prior_mi_stroke, statin_intensity, region
